config.pipeline: NPU coarse.search + NPU IVFPQ.search_preassigned in disjoint probe groups + CPU top-K merge

implementation: Faiss Ascend NPU coarse search + NpuIndexIVFPQ.search_preassigned (at most 64 probes/call), host top-K merge; no CPU vector scan

build.timing_definition: constructor + train + full add + NPU stream synchronization; excludes input preparation and serialization
build.size_definition: serialized CPU-portable Faiss index including centroids, codebooks, vector IDs and PQ codes; not NPU HBM usage

index_construction: Faiss Ascend trains coarse centroids and residual PQ, then encodes/adds raw GloVe vectors; no TensorVS index dependency
timing: Median synchronized full-query sweeps; sum of per-batch CPU query padding + NPU coarse.search + NPU search_preassigned and host top-K merge, including API transfers and CPU control; excludes recall/visit accounting/HBM sampling.
timing_comparison_limit: Faiss accepts/returns host arrays; Tensor uses resident NPU query batches. Coarse centroid storage and query representation use Faiss's FP16 Flat path. The index is independently trained with zero padding, unlike the TensorVS rotated PQ index.
recall: Mean top-K ID overlap with exhaustive raw-IP ground truth divided by K; dataset L2 truth is not used
visited_vectors_definition: Sum of Faiss-built list sizes for the exact assignments passed to search_preassigned, excluding padded queries
memory_metric: Sampled npu-smi current-process HBM peak in a separate sweep; includes index/runtime/workspace/cache
